CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH  --------

For the Petitioner : Mr. Laxman Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Rajendra Ram Ravi Das, A.P.P  --------
05/ Dated 23.03.2023  Heard the parties.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with C.P Case No. 3507 of 2021, for the offences under Sections 498A, 325, 341, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the D.P.
Act, pending in the Court of Ms. Puja Pandey, learned J.M., 1st class, Dhanbad.
Petitioner is the husband of the complainant, Kajal Devi.
It is alleged that after four months of marriage, there was demand of one motorcycle and Two Lakhs Rupees.
To enforce the demand, the informant was tortured and ultimately, she was driven away from matrimonial home.
It was submitted that the learned court below has not issued warrant of arrest against the petitioner to secure his appearance.
It was further submitted that only process under Section 204 Cr.P.C has been issued.
It was also submitted that the complainant has not sustained any injury at the hands of the petitioner.

In the light of the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in the case of Arnesh Kumar Vs.
State of Bihar, reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273, there is no apprehension of arrest of this petitioner.
